title: White Bean Curry with Green Garlic
subtitle: in a coconut and tomato sauce
description: Soft white beans simmered in a spiced coconut and tomato curry, finished with fresh green garlic leaves for a bright, mild garlic flavour.

steps.text: Dry-roast the coriander seeds, mustard seeds and cardamom seeds in a dry pan over medium-low heat for about 1 minute until fragrant. Grind in a food processor or with a mortar and pestle.
Heat the oil in a wide pot and cook the thinly sliced onions for 3 minutes over medium heat until soft. Add the ground spices, sliced chilli, curry paste and kaffir lime leaves and fry for 1 minute.

Add the crushed garlic, palm sugar, lemon zest and lemon juice and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Raise the heat, tear the tomatoes into 3 or 4 pieces by hand, add them to the pot with their juice and bring to the boil. Lower to medium and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the beans (soaked overnight and cooked until completely tender), the coconut milk and salt, and cook for 15 minutes over low heat until the beans absorb the sauce.
Add the green garlic leaves and cook for 2 more minutes until slightly softened but still bright green. Serve immediately.
